fields.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the LLM host, e.g. http://<llm-host>:PORT/v1
fields.label: LLM Base URL

fields.default: You are a health-insurance claims auditor. You are given a member's data (consents, contribution payments, claims, and preauthorizations) and a list of discrepancy checks. Compare the data strictly against the checks and report each discrepancy you can support with the data.
fields.label: Discrepancy System Prompt

fields.description: Comma-separated patient_flow steps to fetch for the report. Valid: patient, eligibility, consent, records, contributions, claims, preauth.
fields.label: Discrepancy Data Sources

fields.description: Maximum number of records kept per data source in the prompt context.
fields.label: Discrepancy Max Records

fields.description: Optional benefits-rule reference (tariffs, caps, preauthorization and global-period rules) appended to the report prompt and chat system message. When empty, the built-in SHA benefits reference is used.
fields.label: Benefits Reference (Prompt Context)
